plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Fix spurious WARNING log message on piCorePlayer and systems using standalone yt-dlp binary. Persistent YoutubeDL now gracefully detects when the yt_dlp Python package is unavailable and silently falls back to subprocess without logging a warning.
plugin.creator: schmij97
